correctness.rationale: Theorem 10.6 of arXiv:2609.06844v1 gives the exact forbidden-pair face model. Reflection permutes the 2n directed incidence vertices without fixed points; every invariant face is a union of disjoint transposed pairs with simplicial orientation sign (-1)^a. The complete reduced Lefschetz sum, including the empty simplex, equals -S_floor(n/2). The explicitly derived four-state transfer gives S_{h+1}=-S_{h-1}, S_0=1, S_1=0, proving S_{2k}=(-1)^k, S_{2k+1}=0 for all k. Proposition 6.2 and Theorem 6.6 determine a unique rational homology degree of dimension one for n congruent 0 or 1 mod 4; the alternating-trace sign then yields the claimed path-reversal eigenvalues. Direct generator-closure and local-word enumerations agree for n=1..11; signed simplicial traces agree for n=1..11; exact mod-2 homology ranks agree for n=1..10; independent half-word sums agree through n=24; recurrence cases agree through n=300. All finite checks supplement rather than replace the general proof.

value.rationale: Path reversal is the canonical nontrivial symmetry of the entire natural family of finite paths. The existing homotopy-sphere classification cannot distinguish the action of the involution by degree +1 from degree -1. The new mod-eight character distinguishes infinitely many of each type, determines the full rational C2-module of reduced homology in every length, and has a concrete topological consequence: the reversal quotient has nonzero rational reduced homology precisely in the +1 cases. The result is an exact uniform structural invariant, not a numerical increment or an isolated small enumeration.
